_note: Version-2 design for the stimulus-generation pilot: pilot/design.json (the recorded run's, which stays unchanged because that run hashes it) plus harness_version 2 and the data the version-2 scripts read. harness_version selects the row and checker contract in pilot/scripts/common.py (absent means 1); it is the pilot harness's version, not manifest_model.json's harness_version, which names the Claude Code version. specialties, swap_types and cell order are version 1's. control_example is the example negative control the generation prompt shows (its {{CONTROL_EXAMPLE}} marker), rewritten for version 2: it carries next_word, its template ends on a probe ending and it is spoken in the first person, as the version-2 prompt asks of every row. probe_endings are the words a template should end on (the probe-point descriptive). concepts_per_call and variant_pairs_per_call are the variant design the prompt asks for (12 concepts, 4 of them with a second patient phrasing on the next line, 16 non-control rows). review_sampling one_row_per_concept draws at most one review row per concept. These are data, not code (engine AGENTS.md: medical vocabulary lives in data files, never in Python source). Copy this file into a version-2 run directory as design.json before planning.
